text: あたまを　つきだし　まっすぐ　つっこんで　こうげきする。

structure.jp: あたまを　つきだし
まっすぐ　つっこんで

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off before ます, with nothing after it, means 'does this, and then...'. It is a written-style way of joining actions. つきだし = 'sticks out, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つっこんで　こうげきする
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here showing the way the attack is done. つっこんで　こうげきする = 'charges in and attacks'.
